remarks: Turn the key and move right into 81 Nichols Avenue! As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the sunny open floorplan, including a formal living room with fireplace and built-ins, dining room, and large kitchen with eat-in and play areas. The adjacent flex room makes for the perfect home office or family room. A full bathroom completes the spacious first level. Upstairs, you will find three generously sized bedrooms, with ample closet space and a beautiful marble bathroom with double vanity. Enjoy your own private backyard retreat, complete with new patio and built-in stone fire pit - the perfect spot for cozy evenings and gatherings. Recent updates also include a repaved driveway, new kitchen lighting, and fresh interior paint. Offering convenience to Stamford's vibrant downtown, schools, parks, and more, don't miss out on this lovingly maintained and special home!
